intent: Underline tabs whose indicator glides like a pen stroke: the leading edge travels on spring.ui and the trailing edge on a softer spring, so the line stretches as it leaves and gathers to the new label as it lands. Panels cross-fade with a 6px slide in the direction of travel. Overflowing tabs scroll behind mask fades with round arrows. Monochrome and dark first, with roving tabindex and auto or manual activation.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with CSS variables set on the root from a theme prop, @container on the root, and a small style block registering the fade widths with @property
stack.animation: motion/react: two motion values for the indicator's edges animated with animate() on different springs and a derived width; AnimatePresence mode popLayout with a custom direction for panels; useInView, variants and animate() for the panel stagger and count-ups; useReducedMotion
stack.icons: lucide-react ChevronLeft and ChevronRight for the overflow arrows

layout.root: @container, full width: a 44px tab row, then a relative panel area with 20px top padding
layout.row: relative; a 1px full-width rail at the foot outside the scroller; a horizontal scroller with a hidden scrollbar holding the tablist (flex, width max-content, min-width 100%, gap 2px, 4px from a 28rem container)
layout.tabs: 44px tall, 10px horizontal padding (14px from 28rem), label then an optional count 6px after; never wrap or truncate
layout.underline: 2px, rounded, on the rail at the foot of the row, spanning the selected label's text only, measured as fractional label bounds relative to strip bounds, corrected for ancestor scale and fractional label width in the strip's coordinates
layout.pill: the selected tab box inset 2px horizontally and 7px vertically, 9px radius, beneath the labels
layout.overflow: 56px mask fades on the scroller driven by two @property length variables (220ms ease); a 40 by 44px arrow over each edge with more tabs past it, holding a 28px round chip; a press scrolls 70% of the visible width; selected or focused tabs scroll to at least 60px inside a faded edge
layout.panel: only the selected panel is rendered; the leaving panel is lifted out of flow by popLayout

typography.label: Geist 500, 14px, tracking -0.01em, nowrap
typography.count: Geist 400, 12.5px, tabular figures, Intl.NumberFormat en-US, plain text

color.dark: ink #f4f4f5, muted #8a8a93, faint #8a8a93, rail 8% white, lines 6% white, surface #18181b, pill #26262b with 8% white hairline and soft black drops, arrow chip #1f1f23 (hover #28282d), focus ink at 75%, ok #3dd68c, busy and warn #f5b946
color.light: ink #18181b, muted #63636c, faint #696973, rail 10% ink, lines 7% ink, surface #f4f4f5, pill #ffffff, arrow chip #ffffff (hover #f4f4f5), focus ink at 70%, ok #1f9d5c, busy and warn #d08a00
color.states: selected label ink, others muted moving to ink on hover with no surface; selected count muted, others faint; disabled 40% with cursor-not-allowed
color.accent: the underline takes the accent prop when given, otherwise the ink; the pill stays neutral; status colour only on 7px dots and the WARN log level

motion.indicator: left and right edges as motion values; moving right, the right edge on spring.ui (stiffness 500, damping 40) and the left on stiffness 300, damping 34; reversed when moving left; first placement jumps; mid-flight picks redirect with velocity; re-measured on resize, counts, tab set and indicator changes; no layoutId
motion.panels: enter from 6px on the side the selection came from with opacity 0 and 3px blur over 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); exit 6px the other way over 170ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1); no animation on first render
motion.panelContents: lead and rows stagger 50ms apart, rising 10px out of a 6px blur over 420ms; figures count up over 700ms; bars and sparkline grow from the baseline after a 300ms delay; meters fill last
motion.hover: label colour over 150ms ease-out; arrow chip background and ink step, chevron nudges 1px outward
motion.press: label dims to 70% opacity without scaling over 90ms (not the tab); arrow chip to 0.94
motion.arrows: arrive with a 4px slide and fade over 200ms, leave over 140ms
motion.reducedMotion: indicator and scrolling jump, panels and contents fade over 150ms or less, figures land at once
motion.panelHeight: ResizeObserver measures the active panel; the enclosing height eases to it over 260ms, jumps under reduced motion and clips during the cross-fade. Outgoing panels become inert and aria-hidden immediately; the panel focus outline sits inside the clip.

responsive.strip: never wraps or truncates; scrolls inside its own box with fades and arrows from 320px upward
responsive.panels: stats keep three columns with fluid figure size; rows truncate their text and keep metadata on the right
responsive.demo: card max-width 680px with 16px side padding on phones and 28px from sm; the strip overflows at 390px at rest and in the 300px narrow column

accessibility: tablist with aria-label and aria-orientation horizontal; native button tabs with role tab, aria-selected, ids and aria-controls on the selected tab
tabpanel with aria-labelledby its tab and tabIndex 0
roving tabindex: only the selected tab is tabbable
ArrowLeft and ArrowRight move focus, wrapping; Home and End jump to the ends; disabled tabs are skipped
auto activation selects on focus; manual moves focus only and Enter or Space opens the focused tab
focus-visible: 2px ring 6px inside the tab, instant and keyboard only; the panel's ring sits 4px outside
overflow arrows are tabIndex -1 and aria-hidden because moving through the tabs scrolls the strip
meters use role meter with min, max and value; chart values carry screen-reader text

content.builtInTabs: Overview, Deployments (24), Logs, Analytics, Domains (3), Variables (18), Storage, Settings; the tabs prop takes the first 2 to 8
content.panels: Overview: 1,418,204 requests, 182 ms p95, 0.04% errors over a 24-bar sparkline. Deployments: three commits with status dots. Logs: a four-line live tail with one WARN 429. Analytics: 48,210 visitors over seven days. Domains: tidewell.app and two siblings. Variables: three masked keys. Storage: three meters, Postgres at 81%. Settings: region, build command and Node version.
content.demoFrame: card with a TIDEWELL / PRODUCTION kicker, the title tidewell-web, the tabs, and a footer with a Narrow column toggle and a key hint that follows activation
demoSteps: click Deployments (the line stretches right and lands, the panel slides in from the right)
click Analytics (the line travels two tabs further)
click Logs (the line travels back, the panel slides in from the left)
press Narrow column (the column narrows to 300px, fades and arrows arrive)
press the end arrow (the strip scrolls to reveal Domains and Variables)

avoid: a layoutId jump or a single spring that keeps the line one width
bounce, overshoot or any animation longer than 800ms
a hover surface on tabs, a bold weight change or a checkmark on the selected tab
counts as tinted chips, sparkle icons, emoji or a gradient underline
a visible scrollbar, an overlay fade, a fade on a strip that does not overflow, or an arrow covering the selected tab
a panel area that doubles in height or jumps while panels cross-fade, or an outgoing panel that remains interactive
decorative colour: status colours only on dots and the warning log level
